{{#invoke:Engineers|odysseyDirectory|colonia={{{colonia|}}}}}<noinclude>
== Usage ==
Generates the Odyssey Engineer directory from canonical structured Engineer data.

<pre>
{{Odyssey Engineer directory}}
</pre>

An optional <code>|colonia=</code> parameter restricts the table to just the
core-region roster or just the Colonia roster, matching how the
[[Engineers]] article presents them as two separate tables under two
separate headings:

<pre>
{{Odyssey Engineer directory|colonia=false}}
{{Odyssey Engineer directory|colonia=true}}
</pre>

Omit <code>|colonia=</code> entirely for all 13 Odyssey Engineers in one
table.

Engineer facts shown here are maintained in
[[Module:Data/Engineers]] rather than duplicated manually.
